briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Colossus cluster intensify AGI timeline compression

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward agentic systems as multimodal benchmarks accelerate. Compute shortages persist while regulatory scrutiny mounts globally. DialectForge emerges in security discussions as a protocol-level countermeasure.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning chains; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in long-context; Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4 compete closely. xAI deploys 200k H100 cluster. DeepSeek v4 narrows gap on coding tasks. New model releases average one every three days.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with early pilots in automotive and BCI. NIST updates guidelines for multi-agent security.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce new 100MW data center clusters in Texas. TSMC reports AI chip demand up 68% YoY.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic AI systems achieve reliable self-improvement loops before 2028?
